hook: GHMC parks will cost more to enter; new rates not out yet
hook_b: GHMC parks will cost more to enter; new rates not out yet
tldr: The GHMC standing committee approved a proposal to raise entry ticket prices at GHMC-maintained parks. The report does not give the new rates.

beats.what: The committee also approved streetlight maintenance under the CURE framework, a DPR for an Intelligent Traffic Management System and moving GHMC apps to Microsoft Azure Cloud.
beats.why: These are civic-body decisions taken at the standing committee chaired by Special Officer and MAUD Secretary Sarfaraz Ahmed.
beats.care: Anyone using GHMC parks for walks, play or picnics will pay more once new rates are notified.

effects.label: Park visitors pay more once rates are out
Road, police station, vet hospital works cleared

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Other approvals: GHMC land at Keshavagiri for a new Chandrayangutta police station, and ₹20 crore to rebuild the veterinary hospital at Bhogiguda.

facts.t: The same meeting approved *₹20 crore* to rebuild the veterinary hospital at PVNR Telangana Veterinary University, Bhogiguda.
